result.title: RayCo4D: Ray-Conditioned Continuous Motion Model for Monocular 4D Dynamic Reconstruction
result.summary: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video requires inferring motion from noisy and intermittently visible observations. Long-range tracks provide valuable geometric constraints, but integrating their fragmented temporal coverage into shared, continuous motion remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{RayCo4D}, a ray-conditioned continuous motion model for monocular 4D reconstruction that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states. Each track is associated with a reference-time 3D query constrained to its camera ray, and its image and depth observations constrain shared latent motion nodes through local many-to-many associations. Each node maintains an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ pose and body-frame velocity at sparse support times. A white-noise-on-acceleration process prior couples neighboring states and defines continuous-time interpolation, allowing observations across visibility intervals to jointly constrain the same latent state sequence.The inferred shared motion is transferred to Gaussian primitives through dual-quaternion blending, while reference-anchored local $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ residuals capture fine-scale non-rigid deformation beyond the shared scaffold. Experiments on diverse monocular dynamic scenes show that RayCo4D achieves competitive novel-view synthesis quality, improves structural and temporal consistency under rapid motion and incomplete tracks, and supports continuous-time rendering.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RayCo4D，把单目视频的动态 4D 重建建模为射线条件下的连续运动模型：将视觉测量与 latent 3D 运动状态显式分离，在稀疏支撑时刻上维护共享的 SE(3) 姿态与体坐标速度节点，用白噪声加速度过程先验耦合相邻状态并定义连续时间插值，使碎片化轨迹观测共同约束同一状态序列，再经 dual-quaternion 混合迁移到 Gaussian primitives。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观测在时间上碎片化、却由过程先验共同约束共享 latent 状态序列」的状态空间做法，可能为 LVR 中跨步骤 latent 推理状态的更新、缓存与不完整证据整合提供借鉴，具体可迁移性需核查。
